title: Rosemary Beach: Atta Boy in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description:
Rosemary Beach: Atta Boy in Seacrest Beach. Atta Boy! You picked a winner!

Guests of this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom cottage in the gated community of Water's Edge enjoy Gulf views, a private pool and the beach just steps away.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Water's Edge with a complimentary set of beach chairs included (March 1 - October 31). Additional beach chairs can be rented from La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Atta Boy! You picked a winner!

Guests of this 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom cottage in the gated community of Water's Edge enjoy Gulf views, a private pool and the beach just steps away. Comfortably sleeping 10 guests, Atta Boy is the perfect location for your next 30A vacation.

Explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach on the 4 included adult bikes! Guests can comfortably walk to restaurants and shopping too.

Amenities:

- Complimentary Access to Rosemary Beach Fitness & Rosemary Beach Tennis

- Complimentary Set of Beach Chairs

- 4 Complimentary Adult Bikes

- Private Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee

*PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER
